name: Aniplex Custom Functionality
brief: Posts each Item line on a sales document to its own G/L entry and keeps the line's description on that entry.
description: Sales posting normally adds Item lines that share a G/L account, posting groups, tax setup and dimensions into a single G/L entry. This app gives every Item line its own G/L entry and copies the sales line description to the new Item Line Description field on the G/L entry.
